g.text: Previous version (379e404) — Case Structure → 0, 9, Event Structure → Event 1

svg.text: This is an example to show how someone can use the JKI State Machine. We show how
you can refactor existing code. We have taken the 3 button dialog that ships with the
base version of LabVIEW and upgraded it to use the JKI State Machine template.
The original VI is located at: <vi.lib>\Utility\error.llb\Three Button Dialog CORE.vi
For instructions on how to use the JKI State Machine, examples and video tutorials, visit:
executes when the state queue is empty
